 from __future__ import annotations

+
 from ansible.plugins.shell.powershell import _parse_clixml, ShellModule

@@ -74,6 +76,34 @@ def test_parse_clixml_multiple_elements():
     assert actual == expected
 
 
+@pytest.mark.parametrize('content, expected', [
+    ('_x000D__x000A_', b'\r\n'),
+    ('_x263A_', '\u263a'.encode()),
+    ('_xD83D__xDE00_', '\U0001f600'.encode()),
+    ('_x005f_', b'_'),
+    ('_x005F_', b'_x005F_'),
+    ('_x005F__x000A_', b'_\n'),
+    ('_x005G_', b'_x005G_'),
+    ('_x123_', b'_x123_'),
+    ('_xD800_', b'\xed\xa0\x80'),
+    ('_xD800__x0041_', b'\xed\xa0\x80A'),
+])
+def test_parse_clixml_escapes(content, expected):
+    data = ('<Objs><S S="Error">%s</S></Objs>' % content).encode()
+    assert _parse_clixml(data) == expected
+
+
+def test_parse_clixml_empty_and_multiple_blocks():
+    data = (b'<Objs><S S="Info">ignored</S><S S="Error" /></Objs>'
+            b'<Objs><S S="Error">first</S><S S="Info">ignored</S>'
+            b'<S S="Error">_x000D__x000A_second</S></Objs>'
+            b'<Objs><S S="Error" /></Objs>'
+            b'<Objs><S S="Error">third</S></Objs>')
+    assert _parse_clixml(data) == b'first\r\nsecond\r\nthird'
+    assert _parse_clixml(data, stream='Other') == b''
+    assert _parse_clixml(b'<Objs><S S="Error" /></Objs><Objs />') == b''
+
+
